typography.font_strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. Use Outfit (Geometric Sans) for high-impact, modern headings with tight tracking (`tracking-tight`). Manrope for clean, legible body text. No Inter or generic defaults.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000 for cards, use #0A0A0A for subtle elevation. Use #10B981 (Emerald) for the primary conversion driver. Hover states must shift to a slightly lighter/more vibrant hue (#059669).

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-20 to py-32 for sections to give breathing room. Mobile sections use py-12.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. High Density for features, Asymmetric Tetris for image galleries. Gap-4 to Gap-6 for tight groupings.
layouts.cards: Google Business Profile inspired cards. Flat solid #0A0A0A backgrounds with a delicate 1px border (#27272A). Rounded corners (rounded-2xl) to feel modern but structured.

hero.style: High impact, deep background. H1 centered or left aligned with prominent WhatsApp CTA. Background can use a subtle radial gradient of the green brand color at 10% opacity for depth.

sticky_bottom_bar.style: Mobile-only (hidden on md+). Fixed at bottom (bottom-0), z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80, border-t border-zinc-800 p-4. Contains two buttons: 'Book on WhatsApp' (Emerald, full width or 60%) and 'Call Now' (Outline/Ghost, 40%).

services_section.style: Bento grid of cards. Each card represents a service (Cleaning, Whitening, Root Canal). Includes an icon, bold title, and short description.

reviews_section.style: Google Review aesthetic adapted to dark mode. White text, #FBBF24 star icons. Use a horizontal scrolling flex container or Swiper for mobile.

gallery_section.style: Asymmetric Tetris grid. Images have rounded corners, subtle hover scale up, and trigger a lightbox on click.

whatsapp_modal.style: Shadcn Dialog. Dark mode form fields. Input focus ring must be the brand green (focus:ring-emerald-500). Full Name, Phone, DOB inputs.

header.style: Crystal Glass. Sticky top-0, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10. Must NOT be fully transparent over content.

motion.general: Subtle and premium. Scroll-triggered entrance animations using Framer Motion (`y: 20, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1` over 0.5s).
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-1`) with a soft glow shadow (`shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.1)]`). Images scale slightly (`scale-105`) inside hidden overflow containers.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a very subtle SVG noise texture overlay fixed over the page background to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Ensure stroke-width is consistent (1.5 or 2).

hero_background_or_accent.description: Clean, sterile modern dental clinic room. Use with a heavy dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black via-black/80 to-transparent) so text is readable.

doctor_portrait.description: Confident male dentist in uniform. Used in the Team/Doctor Intro section.

gallery_1.description: Close up of a beautiful smile, perfect for whitening/results gallery.

gallery_3.description: Macro shot of dental tools for the gallery/services.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not heavily required for this fast-loading microsite. Stick to 2D high-quality assets and Framer Motion for premium feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes APCA/WCAG AA guidelines against the dark background. Green CTA text should be white or very dark #050505 for maximum contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-none`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="whatsapp-booking-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' via standard CSS import.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the layout sections to ensure custom spacing and overlaps are achieved easily. Avoid rigid container components if they restrict full-bleed backgrounds.
Use Shadcn UI for the Dialog (Booking Modal).
Implement the mobile sticky CTA bar so it only appears on screens smaller than `md`.
Format the Services and Reviews like Google Business Profile cards: clean, bordered, flat dark backgrounds.
Ensure 'Book on WhatsApp' deep link is formatted as `https://wa.me/[phone_number]?text=[prefilled_message_url_encoded]`.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, input fields, and major section wrappers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align paragraphs. Use left-alignment for body text.
Add transition utilities to specific properties (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`) rather than `transition-all`.
Create depth through z-index, borders, and shadows instead of flat elements.
Ensure the hero background is deeply overlaid so the text doesn't clash with the image.
Do not use transparent headers without backdrop-blur.
